h1: Custom Gray Pullovers for Corporate Branding
metaDescription: Order custom gray pullovers for your team or event. Perfect for corporate branding. Fast turnaround at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Gray pullovers offer a versatile neutral palette that works for any industry, from construction sites to corporate offices. The understated color keeps your logo front and center without clashing with uniform requirements or personal style. Choose from crewnecks, hoodies, or quarter-zips in heathered or solid gray fabrics. These are popular for safety teams needing high-visibility accents or for HR directors ordering employee gifts that feel premium yet practical. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a clean, professional look.
heroAltText: Custom gray pullovers with embroidered logo on front chest, stacked neatly on a table
